headline: Continue, narrowed, with a stop rule. An honest negative selection run: kick-arisen markers bred true in 0 of 3 on-divisions (2 independent kicks), the cells never die on their own, and the gate still has no resolved Laplacian control. xcell-evo2 takes over the family's L6[L3] (low) from the retracted xcell-turn. Next: one decisive heredity assay of arisen markers, gated vs resolved ungated arms, in the fast-division regime. L7 is retried only if it passes.
message_to_researcher:
Decision: CONTINUE, narrowed, with a stop rule (promise 5). This was an honest, well-corrected sprint: every r1 fix landed and xcell-turn is retracted. S and N share one kick/kill RNG, which makes them identical-event twins. Good design.

Verdicts:
- xcell-evo2-S/N: L6[L3], low confidence. It is now the family's L6. S0 reaches gen 6 (0 merges) and N1 gen 4. The biologist's crops (judge-scratch/fisim-beyond-laplacian-r2-biologist/S0_chain.png) show clean ringed fissions at t=450/510/570/960. Confidence is low because only 2/6 runs reach gen>=3, bodies are planted, deaths are imposed and division is Gray-Scott-class. Ship birth strips.
- L7: Contradicted, and your headline is wrong. kinds.json logs on->on+off in S0, S1 and N1, from 2 independent kicks. Arisen marks bred true 0/3: a fresh polar kick had not filled the cell before the pinch (S1_kick115.png). Faster division alone makes this worse.
- xcell-her: L3, high confidence. Arm L is not a control yet: one Dh, no image, and no gated rows. Its Dh=0.02 fronts are ~1 px wide and blocky, and get stranded behind drifting bodies (judge-scratch/fisim-beyond-laplacian-r2-skeptic/larm_check.png). Beyond-diffusion stays <=1.
- xcell-a: L4b[L3], medium, unchanged. xcell-turn: L6 withdrawn.

MAIN EXPERIMENT: heredity of kick-arisen markers, gated vs resolved Laplacian arms.
- Use the xcell-evo2-N genome. Division is limited by space, not kc: free-space daughters re-divide every 50-70 t. Use ~10x dilution (KILL_RATE~1.0) or fewer founders; kc 0.35-0.5 only as a fallback.
- At t~100, kick (sigma 1.5, amp 2.5) a random interior point of half the cells. Log the centroid offset and the time to the next pinch.
- Arms (same grid, IC, seeds and event RNG; 3 seeds; T~600): gated (beta_h=5, Dh=0.3); ungated Dh 0.05 and 0.1 at dx=0.5; ungated Dh 0.02 at dx=0.25.
- Classify each on-division from raw per-daughter h, and count conversions of intact cells. Ship h crops on a fixed absolute scale, plus frames.npz.
- Pass: >=20 on-divisions per arm, gated on+on >=80%, and every resolved ungated arm clearly worse.
- Stop rule: one fix is allowed (a cell-filling kick, faster h spread inside the ring, or within-cell purification). If gated marks still split, or an ungated arm matches the gate, drop L7. Return to the brief instead: an independent self-made membrane field carrying the gate.

SECONDARY
1. Only if the assay passes: S/N twins at fast dilution, 3 seeds per arm, T=2000. Use a thresholded g so off-cells are exactly neutral, and measure s as per-kind inter-division time. Pass: an arisen lineage with >=3 consecutive on+on, and S above N's spread in 3/3 seeds.
2. Intrinsic death inside the genome: screen one conserved cost split at division, to replace disk erasure.
3. Correct the r2 headline.

BORROW:
- origin/claude/alife-chemotaxis-motility:research/alife/threads/chemotaxis-motility/REPORT_r2.md Mechanism 2 (growth purifies a body before fission), plus fission.py.
- origin/claude/alife-active-droplets:research/alife/threads/active-droplets/REPORT_r1.md Mechanism 4 (cross-inhibition).
- origin/claude/alife-autopoiesis:research/alife/threads/autopoiesis/kindtrack.py (conversion counts). Their REPORT_r2 shows contagion through phi tails, which your gate may fix.

leaderboard_rows.note: Selection experiment, arms S and N: identical-event twins (kicks and dilution from one shared RNG), 3+3 seeds, T=2000. L6: S0 reaches gen 6 (11 persistent splits, 0 merges) and N1 gen 4. The biologist's merge-aware movie tracker and birth crops confirm clean rod->dumbbell->two ringed daughters in the S0 chain (t=450/510/570/960). Only 2/6 runs reach gen>=3 by labkit, the bodies are planted, every death is an imposed disk erasure, and division is Gray-Scott-class. L7 Contradicted: on->on+on 0 in 6 runs, and all 3 on-divisions (2 independent kicks) were on->on+off, by polar segregation of a fresh kick. Final on-cells S 1/0/2 vs N 1/1/0. About 0.7 dilution generations per run, so the test is underpowered. L3 rests on the band ring plus r1 gate ablations, which were not repeated in evo2.

Two planted kinds breed true: 46 divisions in r1, 0 mixed, 0 switches. Removing the membrane gate on h erases every on-lineage while body and division are unchanged (3 judges). kb -10% breaks it. Sprint-2 arm L (ungated, Dh=0.02) loses all markers by t~100, reproduced by the skeptic on seed 11 at 64². The ungated fronts are ~1 px wide and blocky, though, so this is not yet a matched Laplacian control. Kick-arisen markers in xcell-evo2 bred true in 0 of 3 divisions, so heredity is shown only for planted, cell-filling domains. L6 Weak (one counted generation). L7 Contradicted.

m4 gliders (8/8 cells, 7.9-8.6 body lengths, 3 seeds) with a band-deposited membrane ring (m 0.55 at the rim, 0.22 at the centre, ~0 outside). The ring holds a fast D=4 cargo: 1.24 at the centre vs 0.43 with the gate off, dt-converged. The body is exactly m4 (K=0), so the compartment is passive. Part of the m field is a trailing wake. L4a Weak: one cell, 29.6% erased. Unchanged in sprint 2. Biologist dissent from r1: L3 Weak.

RETRACTED by the researcher in r2, and withdrawn as the family's L6 evidence. The waste was gated by cargo through a channel-index bug, and every founder was planted with q=1.2. Its gen 5/6/4 is colonization of a box emptied by poisoned founders, by 2 survivors, not turnover. With m-gated waste the world goes extinct by t~32. Superseded by xcell-evo2.

cross_pollination.suggestion: Your r2 membrane_kinds result is that catalyst crosses between touching cells through their phi tails: conversions exceed mutations in 6/6 seeds, even under phi^4 and the hard gate. fisim's perm operator div(D exp(-beta*m) grad f) gates the flux at the wall itself. In xcell-her, on and off cells sit interleaved in a touching lattice with 0 switches in 46 divisions, and removing the gate erases every on-lineage (origin/claude/alife-fisim-beyond-laplacian:research/alife/threads/fisim-beyond-laplacian/xgenome.py, XGENOME_SPEC.md, packs/xcell-her/seed0/sheet.png). Try gating catalyst mobility by exp(-beta*4phi(1-phi)) in arms B and C. Also log the time from each mutation to the next division: fisim's kick-arisen marks split unequally (0/3 on+on) when the mutation had not filled the cell before the pinch.

ad5-evolve's L7 is capped at low because selection happens only during colonization, with 0 deaths. fisim r2 has a cheap fix that comes with an exact neutral arm. It draws the mutation kicks and the chemostat deaths (random disk erasure) from one state-independent RNG shared by the S and N arms, so the arms are identical-event twins (origin/claude/alife-fisim-beyond-laplacian:research/alife/threads/fisim-beyond-laplacian/worlds/xcell-evo2-S/world.py and evo.py). Their lesson: at ~0.7 dilution generations per run, the S/N test could not see selection. Set dilution near your free-space division rate.

A lab lesson from fisim r2 (REPORT_r2.md sections 3-4 on origin/claude/alife-fisim-beyond-laplacian). Unplanted m4-type dissipative-soliton cells never died under gated waste, slow global food or a cap, and froze at 12-21 cells, because division does not dilute a concentration-type waste. Intrinsic death needs an extensive cost that is split at division, such as the maintenance decay of body matter in your mcfd-MIRd. Check whether your dormant-lattice long runs lack exactly this, before tuning cycles.

sporecell freezes into a ~40-cell lattice. fisim r2's identical-event chemostat, random disk erasure drawn from a state-independent RNG shared across arms (origin/claude/alife-fisim-beyond-laplacian:research/alife/threads/fisim-beyond-laplacian/worlds/xcell-evo2-S/world.py), would keep births going. It would also pair sporecell-gene with an exact neutral twin. Set the dilution rate near the free-space division rate, or selection stays invisible.

Make a fresh mark take the whole cell before it pinches, using one of two mechanisms. (1) chemotaxis-motility's own-density cooperative growth, which purifies a body before fission (origin/claude/alife-chemotaxis-motility:research/alife/threads/chemotaxis-motility/REPORT_r2.md Mechanism 2). (2) active-droplets' within-droplet cross-inhibition (origin/claude/alife-active-droplets:research/alife/threads/active-droplets/REPORT_r1.md Mechanism 4). For per-daughter readouts and birth strips, use chemotaxis-motility's fission.py (dense tracker, both daughters survive >= 40 t). For conversions of intact cells, use autopoiesis's kindtrack.py (origin/claude/alife-autopoiesis:research/alife/threads/autopoiesis/kindtrack.py). For intrinsic death inside the genome, see lenia-multichannel's maintenance decay (packs/mcfd-MIRd) and chemotaxis-motility's toxic self-waste (packs/toxforage).

rubric_issues: labkit colour scales: per-pack 99.5-percentile scales saturate bistable marker channels when on-cells are rare, so kinds cannot be read from the sheets of fisim evo2 S1/S2/N1/N2. Kind channels need fixed absolute scales or scales shared across arms.

labkit rim_vs_outside (about 0.5) misreads band membranes, because its outside annulus sits on the m peak. The evo2 packs also lack radial.png. Per-channel radial profiles around track centroids are still needed (requested in r1).

L7: require off-kind-daughter counts for kinds that ARISE during the run, reported separately from planted kinds. In fisim, planted kinds bred true in 46/46 divisions while arisen marks bred true in 0/3, so a planted-kind heredity result must not stand in for heredity of variation.

L7 power: a selection test in which arisen lineages get fewer than ~3 divisions each should be reported as 'underpowered (non-detection)', not as a measured null. World-level stochastic events outside the genome (kicks, disk erasure) must be declared in META and scored under PhySim potential.
